title: Lower bound for randomized acceptance
statement: Let $P$ be a Boolean predicate on $m$ signs, let $\delta\in[0,1]$, and fix a sign vector $x\in\{\pm1\}^m$. Set $\mu_i=(1-\delta)x_i$. Then the indicator that $P$ accepts $x$, minus $m\delta/2$, is at most the randomized value of $P$ at means $\mu$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean predicate on a finite number $m$ of signs
A fixed sign vector of length $m$
